exposure: Polycystic ovary syndrome (PCOS) (different phenotypes based on the Rotterdam criteria)
cohort: 199 singleton pregnancies in women with PCOS and HA between 2003 and 2011, matched with 995 controls based on date of childbirth.
finding: While the incidence of adverse obstetric outcomes and newborn anthropometric measures were comparable between different PCOS phenotypes and women with HA, patients with PCOS or HA had a higher risk of gestational diabetes mellitus compared to controls.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section rates were similar between patients and controls.
